title: The Bright Sessions
subtitle: Therapy sessions for the strange and unusual, with a larger sci-fi story waiting underneath.
description: A character-first science-fiction drama about therapy, power, secrecy, and the personal cost of being unusual in a world that wants to study you.

length.label: Official site states the show ran for seven seasons.

archiveTake: One of the cleaner entry points for listeners who want emotionally legible sci-fi before they want maximal world mechanics.

similarReasons.ars-paradoxica: A denser science-fiction branch if the speculative mechanics matter as much as the characters.
similarReasons.story: Keeps the softer emotional legibility intact while stepping away from the superpowered frame.
similarReasons.case-63: A tighter, more suspense-forward route once you want the sci-fi idea compressed into a cleaner thriller.
